summary: The weighted max-convolution lemma follows correctly from the ordered sumset bound and layer-cake integration. The integral height decomposition is exact, the one-body Brunn-Minkowski step applies to every positive source-fiber pair, and the height-zero diagonal targets supply precisely the max-convolution term needed for the off-diagonal product estimate. All factors 4, 8, and 16 are consistent. The degree-tag product aliases yield p_xi <= P_xi^A without an ordered-pair factor error, the accepted parity-maximum ledger applies because G < W/2, and the cross-color overlap count charges each active target set once per color. The constants in the final dichotomy reduce exactly to 144/553, and the proof makes no collision-to-core or other terminal claim.
